games.name: BOMBANANA!
games.short_description: Chaotic bomb disposal fun with friends & monkeys! Work together as a 3-player co-op team of blind, deaf, and mute monkeys. Each player has only part of the needed information. Communicate, solve puzzles, and race against the clock. Can you defuse the bombs before they explode?
games.indie_reason: Steam marks it as Indie and no large publisher matched
